name: pharaonic/laravel-modulator
description: Laravel-native modules for Laravel: convention-based discovery, nested submodules, package-provided modules with local overrides, and production-safe autoloading without per-module composer.json files.

suggest.filament/filament: Registers the Filament resources, pages and widgets of modules (module:make:filament-resource).
suggest.livewire/livewire: Registers the Livewire components of modules (module:make:livewire).
